items.title: Chrome Vulnerabilities Let Attackers Execute Arbitrary Code and Crash System
items.description: Google has released a critical security update for the Chrome Stable channel, addressing two high-severity vulnerabilities that expose users to potential arbitrary code execution (ACE) and denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. The update pushes the browser version to 144.0.7559.132/.133 for Windows and macOS, and 144.0.7559.132 for Linux. The technology giant confirmed that the rollout will occur…

items.title: Hackers Exploiting React Server Components Vulnerability in the Wild to Deploy Malicious Payloads
items.description: Two months following the disclosure of CVE-2025-55182, exploitation activity targeting React Server Components has evolved from broad scanning into consolidated, high-volume attack campaigns.
